name: Darwin's Hoard
purpose: Keeps every discovery (GitHub repository, article, paper, video, idea) that could improve Faustus or a Hoard with where it came from, what was proposed for which app, what was delivered (commits, Ágora tasks) and the capability tree of the family (Faustus > Hoard Hub > Hoards > modules > capabilities > tools). Assistants check here before analysing a repository again, ask which app already does something, and record proposals, state changes and gaps.
notes: Python 3.11+ with FastAPI and the vendored Hoard Link copy (darwin_hoard/hoard_link). Data in data/darwin.db (SQLite). Reads, never writes, the radar Markdown files, the hub (apps and Ágora tasks) and Faustus's tool catalogue; works with every other app stopped (last snapshot of the tree).
